evals.name: browser-with-only-this-skill
evals.prompt: I am using an offline browser LLM chat. I only attached this SKILL.md; no other skills installed, no CLI, JavaScript runner, filesystem, context meter, or API for creating chats. My exact mission is 'Finish the supplier comparison without inventing prices.' Supplier A has been transcribed, supplier B's warranty appendix is missing, and supplier C has not been read. My latest correction is to prioritize warranty before price. Prepare the complete handoff I can use in a fresh chat before context is lost. Deliver the artifact now; do not claim tool operations happened or just offer to continue.
evals.expected_output: Immediate complete copyable continuation + bootstrap, preserves exact task/correction/missing evidence, no other skill/template/runtime prerequisite, early manual new session and explicit unknown timing.
assertions: Delivers a complete copyable checkpoint and actionable successor startup instructions now, without requiring another skill, template file, shell, JavaScript runtime or API.
Preserves the exact mission, warranty-before-price correction, A transcribed, B warranty appendix missing and C unread; does not invent supplier content or prices.
Uses an early manual fresh-chat path for unavailable telemetry and session controls; makes no universal timing, fabricated digest, file save or launched-session claim.
Explains destination attachment/source gaps and explicit predecessor stop/manual takeover before successor mission work.

evals.name: desktop-rejects-false-readiness
evals.prompt: Offline desktop-app scenario. The handoff is armed for the exact goal {'objective':'Finish migration A without changing billing behavior','token_budget':12000}; I explicitly set that budget. Host tools can create and inspect new sessions. This session has 42,000 resident tokens, an effective 100,000 window, and a 60,000 compaction boundary. The proposed tool result may add 14,000 tokens and handoff needs 6,000. Current checkpoint v3 was read back; its detached digest is D3, nonce N3, workspace snapshot W3. One reserved fresh-session creation timed out. Host lookup now finds candidate S2, but S2 acknowledges v2/D2/W2, omits the goal budget, and its headroom is unknown. The old owner still owns the task and has untracked files. Give the precise next steps and an updated continuation-status block. Do not call real tools or claim an actual handoff happened.
evals.expected_output: Defer tool projected62000, checkpoint untracked state, keep existing candidate reservation/owner, fix checkpoint delivery/goal and verify budget+headroom independent host evidence before transfer, no blind new session/fork or false readiness.
assertions: Computes 42000 + 14000 + 6000 = 62000 against the 60000 boundary and defers the proposed large tool action.
Retains old ownership and the existing reserved candidate after timeout, reconciles S2 instead of blindly creating another session, and preserves actual untracked contents.
Rejects v2/D2/W2 and omitted budget; requires current v3/D3/W3 acknowledgment plus exact active goal objective and explicit 12000 budget creation then inspection.
Requires fresh independent candidate identity/status, sufficient context headroom, artifact/permission checks and quiesced writers before atomic transfer; status accurately remains not transferred.
